lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That he tied her up and stabbed her.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Where did he say he did this?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What else did he tell you?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He said how he tried to hide it.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: How did he try to hide it, what did he tell you?

lines.speaker: BRENDON
lines.text: He tried to cover it with branches, a car hood

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: The car you're talking about, her truck? Her jeep, he tried to cover it with what?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did he say anything about shooting her. Tell me again how he said he killed her.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He said he tied her up and stabbed her.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did he say where he stabbed her?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Did he say how he got, did he say he took her into the pit or did he kill her out by the garage or his house?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Is that what he told you, he took her into the pit?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And he stabbed her where, in the truck you said?
